invariants.label: single-transactional-commit-authority
invariants.gap_note: Single transactional authority and atomicity are proven; the clause 'per-document JSONL files are not the serving authority' has no executed negative test asserting JSONL non-authority (no serving path may read per-document ledgers).

invariants.label: crash-injection-no-partial-state
invariants.gap_note: Crash atomicity for mutations/decisions/publication pointers/effects is proven on SQLite; source-cursor and full recovery crash injection runs in the PG+S3 industrial environment (env-gated here). No cross-topology crash claim beyond the CI-grade lab.

invariants.label: blob-vs-observation-identity
invariants.gap_note: Separation is demonstrated indirectly (GC rescue keys on blob_key; evidence classes are distinct record identities); a direct dedup-collision test naming both identities is missing.

invariants.label: canonical-id-cross-platform
invariants.gap_note: Determinism proven multi-OS × multi-Python on x86_64 with committed golden constants; the invariant's literal cross-language and ARM64 clauses have no executable fixture (no second-language implementation, no ARM64 runner).

invariants.label: cross-page-fragment-preservation
invariants.gap_note: Continuation-edge and alternative-preservation semantics exist; the all-fragments + full-provenance preservation property for cross-page continuations and multi-page tables has no executable assertion.

invariants.label: redaction-all-paths
invariants.gap_note: Redaction policy exists only as audit-text redaction plus retrieval identity rotation; the invariant's enumerated surface (image/cache/index/visual vector/export/cursor) is untested and may be partially unimplemented.

invariants.label: verification-status-relative
invariants.gap_note: Relativity is structural (every dimension is matched before an outcome), yet the 'one unresolved region does not make the entire document unusable' property has no direct two-region assertion.

invariants.label: calibration-artifact-discipline
invariants.gap_note: Calibration artifact schema carries method/version/sample/support/CI/shift but not named population/assumptions/expiry fields; zero observed catastrophic failures are reported as counts only.

invariants.label: routing-stays-shadow-until-proven
invariants.gap_note: Routing demonstrably stays shadow/offline, but the promotion condition has not been evaluated against truly held-out shift + catastrophic utility (same fixture trains and evaluates); evidence is fixture-scoped.

invariants.label: review-policy-operational
invariants.gap_note: Verification-policy operational usability (review coverage, queue time, bypass rate) is an acknowledged open follow-up in docs/reference/verification-risk.md; only the extraction review lane is tested.

invariants.label: no-training-routing-transparency
environments: deterministic local lane (real kernel/publication/query authorities per document; specialist responses replayed offline from the committed PR80B cache - no network, no credentials)

invariants.label: admission-memory-envelope
invariants.gap_note: PR69 landed the admission subsystem keyed to the pinned preprocessor's visual-token/memory envelope (runtime_capacity.py + worker/thread gates) with deterministic, race, worker-integration, and OOM-injection suites green and a committed estimate-mode characterization artifact; the invariant's full wording additionally requires dynamic-resolution GPU OOM-stress evidence on real CUDA hardware, which has not been executed yet, so coverage stays partial.

invariants.label: model-lease-anti-eviction
environments: cpu-test-env (real threads/locks/conditions; the lease semantics are process-level and make no VRAM claim)

invariants.label: external-effect-semantics-declared
invariants.gap_note: Local exactly-once acceptance and truthful refusal/reconciliation are proven; the per-destination external-effect semantics declaration driven by real destination primitives is absent.

invariants.label: failure-injection-truthful-outcomes
invariants.gap_note: Cancellation/failover/disk/model-service(lease-lapse) classes are covered on the SQLite lane and DB-outage/WAL semantics on the PG failover lab; shared-memory pressure is not injected anywhere (the shared-memory lane was measured and rejected in PR68A), and no literal model-service crash injection exists.

invariants.label: connector-idempotency-cursor-atomicity
environments: deterministic local sqlite lane (migrated file DB, real kernel commit spine, real content-addressed store, real authorization overlay; scripted provider)

invariants.label: revocation-slo
invariants.gap_note: Revocation effectiveness without content events is proven and measured; a declared numeric SLO (bound/latency) is neither declared nor asserted.

invariants.label: disclosed-context-non-revocability-doc
environments: deterministic local lane (canonical reference doc, MCP guide, runtime agent-guide resource, and live tool description read from the working tree)

invariants.label: packet-reuse-invalidation
invariants.gap_note: Most named triggers are explicit identity dimensions with tests; 'citation change' has no identity dimension and renderer/tokenizer rotation is covered only via serialization_profile + publication tokenizer fields.

invariants.label: trace-not-entailment-proof
environments: deterministic local sqlite lane (migrated file DB through Alembic head 20260823_0015, real kernel commit spine, real publications/authorization, real EvidencePacket delivery chains)

invariants.label: stale-review-rejection
invariants.gap_note: Backend review-commit staleness is proven; UI screens, approvals, exports, and operational status exposing as-of revision/policy/completeness end-to-end (including frontend) is unproven.

invariants.label: scale-envelope-economics
invariants.gap_note: Measured dimensions: object counts, copy bytes, transfer amplification, failover RTO components. Missing as measured fields: WAL/write amplification, retained-generation accounting, FTS/vector/visual storage, cold starts, review burden, reprocessing cost, database-row envelopes.

invariants.label: visual-retrieval-selective-economics
invariants.gap_note: Selectivity + disable proven and storage/update costs partially measured; ACL complexity is unmeasured and no enabled-vs-disabled operational-load delta exists.

invariants.label: subsystem-owner-rollback-kill
invariants.gap_note: Utility is measured per capability slice; the required per-subsystem support owner, rollback, expiry, and kill-condition matrix does not exist in any artifact.

invariants.label: leadership-claim-discipline
invariants.gap_note: No leadership-claim completeness fields or validators exist: workflow, competitors, catastrophic budget, and review burden are not named in any artifact schema or test.

invariants.label: final-displacement-test
invariants.gap_note: Concession language and specialist comparisons exist; the final rational-user displacement test (better accepted end-to-end outcome by leaving Marker UI) has never been executed as such.
